annotation_sizing.invariant: author-performed labels are diagnostic evidence and §10.4 hierarchy input. They are NEVER described as independent validation, in any artifact, at any point. The v3 record already carries the same disposition for its 120 author labels.
annotation_sizing.not_started: no labelling session has been started. §2.5 requires the author to size and agree one first.

option_1_section_10_3.rule: min(150, N_c) per class per instrument, with the fail class additionally split by realised margin
option_1_section_10_3.what_it_buys: nothing that Gate 1 can use. §10.3 requires an annotator INDEPENDENT of the design and analysis team; the annotator here is the study author, so the basis is HUMAN_VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE however many items are labelled. This is the size needed for a human_validated basis that is unreachable.

option_2_section_10_4.driver: the discordant set between the two conditions, plus a matched concordant control sample of the same size
option_2_section_10_4.items: computed from the paired comparison; see section_10_4
option_2_section_10_4.rule: enough paired items to separate the judging conditions under the §10.4 hierarchy's fourth criterion
option_2_section_10_4.what_it_buys: the fourth criterion of the §10.4 selection hierarchy, which is the only criterion the judge run cannot decide on its own

protocol_properties_required_of_any_sess: blind: no arm, model label, companion, verifier verdict or other annotator's work visible
tool-assisted: the annotator marks each qualifying feature and the interface tallies the annotator's OWN marks; no automatic detection, highlighting, counting or normalisation
fail-class stratification by realised margin: exactly one against larger, reported separately

rate.measured_from: this annotator's own v3 sessions: 56 items in 52.4 min and 64 items in 69.2 min; median inter-item gaps 49.2 s and 27.7 s

annotation_sizing.why_tool_assisted_and_not_automatic: all four v3 human-to-verifier disagreements were unaided off-by-one counting errors at margin one, and four independent recounts reproduced the verifier every time. Automatic counting would remove the disagreement by removing the measurement.

artifact: Gate 1 readiness: C4, C5 and the annotation sizing

v3_sealed_set.disposition: stays sealed. Nothing in dci1v4 can open it, and it is not reused for v4.
v3_sealed_set.verification_method: file digest only; no item id was read, displayed or used

v4_candidate_set.derivation: deterministic round-robin over the six instrument x class x fail-margin strata in item-id order over the registered §12.2 ladder screen pool
v4_candidate_set.not_sealed_because: sealing is a Gate 1 act and Gate 1 is not approved. The set is also provisional: it covers A and B only, and must be re-derived once the reference pool is final and the family verifiers exist, because a final-check set that cannot exercise an admitted instrument is not a final check of it.
rules_when_it_is_sealed: sealed at Gate 1 and its hash recorded
opened at most once, after every autorater choice is frozen
never rerun after a failure to obtain a better result

c4_sealed_final_check_set.why_a_new_set: the v4 instrument population differs from v3's -- v3's set was composed for the exact-count rule alone and cannot exercise the word-length rule or any family verifier -- so per C4 a new sealed set is required rather than reuse

classification: Gate 1 input evidence. Gate 1 is NOT approved, nothing is sealed, and no labelling session was started.
